description: CPU scheduling worked out exactly like the textbook: Gantt chart and per-process finish, turnaround, waiting and response time, plus averages, for FCFS, SJF (SPN), SRTF (SRT), Round Robin, HRRN, non-preemptive priority and multilevel feedback (FB). Checked against the published solutions (Stallings 9th ed. table 9.5, Silberschatz slides 5.11–5.20). The tie-breaking rules that books leave unsaid are stated in `conventions` — that is where hand-made answers and models usually disagree. Returns a link that replays it step by step.

fbQuantum.description: FB only: quantum 1 in every queue, or 2^i in queue i (Stallings). Default 1

processes.description: One per process, comma separated: name:arrival:burst, or name:arrival:burst:priority for PRIORITY (lower number = higher priority). E.g. "A:0:3, B:2:6, C:4:4, D:6:5, E:8:2"
